references.text: Moses conveys the Lord's words to Aaron's sons and all Israel, as also seen here in Leviticus 21:24 where Moses speaks to Aaron, his sons, and all the children of Israel.
Moses is commanded to speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the children of Israel, the same recipient group as in Leviticus 21:24.
Moses is to speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the children of Israel about sacrificial regulations, parallel to the delivery in 21:24.
Moses conveys God's words to the people, a recurring pattern where Moses serves as the intermediary between God and Israel.
Moses spoke these words to all Israel, the same mediating role as in Leviticus 21:24.
